verdict.rationale: Scribe's API documents a per-request retention control: setting enable_logging to false puts the request in zero retention mode. That is a direct, first-party retention capability. Nothing in the evidence covers deleting stored transcripts or audio, configurable retention periods, or account-level retention settings, and data residency is location control, not retention or deletion. missing for 10: documented deletion of stored transcripts/audio, configurable retention windows or account-level policy, independent corroboration of zero-retention behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: When enable_logging is set to false zero retention mode will be used for the request.
